svg.text: 01 Who are the users? 46-55 and 56+ account for ~76%.

text.font-family: Barlow Condensed, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 02 What do they buy? Phone, Coat and Tea dominate pageviews.

text.font-family: Barlow Condensed, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 03 Are they loyal? D1 retention is only 1.70%.

text.font-family: Barlow Condensed, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 04 How do they convert? Cart is not mandatory; direct purchase is 99.70%.

text.font-family: Barlow Condensed, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 05 Why do stores grow? High rating does not equal high traffic; top stores absorb share.
